summary: Test-only follow-up to merged #902, adding the control I named as the one limitation my #902 pin did not cover. Verified test-only rather than accepting it: git diff --numstat base..head is a single line, tests/unit/test_confirmation_exit_fanout.py 38/0, and git diff over src/ is EMPTY — production code is byte-identical to base 0b9d16b7, which is current origin/main with #902 merged. THE DECISIVE CHECK: the mutation that was INERT on #902 now KILLS. Removing _end_confirmation_unprotected_interval(resolution=flat) from _recover_released_confirmation_webull_leg at service.py:3981 — the exact source location that left all 17 fan-out tests GREEN when I mutated it during the #902 review — now turns test_recovery_flat_finalizes_released_unprotected_interval RED at released_unprotected_seconds_max=0.000 instead of 4.000. Restored: 18/18. The recovery-flat branch is now pinned by a control that can come out false. The test uses a monkeypatched clock advanced by exactly 4s inside the broker read, so the 4.000 is deterministic and not wall-clock flake, and it asserts the durable Webull managed row is closed, COVERAGE-RESTORED is emitted with resolution=managed_episode_closed, and both the per-leg seconds and the summary max carry 4.000. I ACCEPT CODEX-2'S CORRECTION OF MY OWN #902 PIN, having verified it independently two ways rather than taking it: (1) reading the code — _close_confirmation_flat_leg calls _clear_exit_reservation_release on close, and that function pops the key from _confirmation_unprotected_since and emits COVERAGE-RESTORED, so the live current count is already cleared on this path; (2) the mutant's own output — released_unprotected_current=0 appears in BOTH the passing and the failing run. ⇒ My #902 pin summary stated the regression as 'leaving the symbol in _confirmation_unprotected_since forever, inflating released_unprotected_current and the max duration'. THAT STATED MECHANISM WAS FALSE. The real regression is narrower: the elapsed interval is lost from the decision summary. The conclusion that the branch needed a control still stands and this PR supplies it, but the harm I described did not exist as written. Recorded append-only at corrections/pr-902-uncovered-current-count.md on this branch, per the #898 precedent. validate PASS on both runs; mergeable MERGEABLE; single commit with one recognized agent marker.
